stories.title: More than 400 attend opening day of free Flintshire summer programme
stories.summary: More than 400 children and family members attended the opening day of Fit, Fed and Read, as the free summer programme returned to Flintshire. Launch sessions took place in Flint and Sealand, offering families an afternoon of free activities, food and reading. stories.title: First Minister presses new Prime Minister for powers over policing, justice and rail
stories.summary: Wales’ First Minister has called on the new Prime Minister to hand Wales greater powers over policing, justice, rail and the Crown Estate during their first official conversation. stories.title: Crews remain at Hope Mountain and Pentre Halkyn wildfires as national mutual aid drafted in
stories.summary: Fire crews remain at wildfires on Hope Mountain and at Pentre Halkyn as the scale of fires burning across North Wales prompts a request for national help. stories.title: New aircraft hangar approved at Hawarden Airport’s Aviation Park
stories.summary: A new aircraft hangar has been approved at Hawarden Airport to house a client’s private jet.
